scope.boundary: Reception local real-component computer-vision comparison and fail-closed runtime-delivery hardening; this is not completion of the full multi-room HD Enhancement goal

outcome.plainLanguageConclusion: Computer vision proves that the two renders differ consistently in five usable views. It cannot prove which render is more faithful to the physical Reception Room without a registered real-room reference and human review.

strictCurrentCheckoutReplay.reason: Two of the 15 selected capture-environment files changed after capture.

evidenceVerification.replayBoundary: The 15-file manifest is a selected capture-critical inventory, not a complete transitive dependency closure. The immutable screenshot and CV bundle verifies, but a bit-identical recapture from the current checkout is not claimed.

publicPresentation.futureRequirement: One immutable presentation contract must bind the exact group transform, camera policy and route, and renderer-profile digest; the browser must apply those exact reviewed values.

closedRisks: Dedicated private runtime-profile R2 credentials and bucket are separate from legacy and Foundry storage, with no public URL fallback.
Full member bytes are size- and SHA-256-verified before release.
Transform and QA identifiers are immutable; exact retries are idempotent and changed content returns HTTP 409.
Concurrent first registrations recover PostgreSQL duplicate-key races as exact retry 200 or immutable 409; unrelated errors are rethrown.
Public approval requires all 11 required QA checks to pass, structured Spark loadStatus=loaded, human-reviewed evidence, and the exact signed-transform digest.
Authorization and immutable package/member identity are re-read immediately before bytes are sent.

Anonymous delivery is limited to two active responses, 16 FIFO waiters, 16 MiB per member, a 30-second upstream timeout, a 180-second absolute response deadline, and 24 requests per minute per client IP.
A bounded 64 MiB, 16-entry, five-minute verified-byte LRU and identical-content single-flight reduce repeated private storage reads without sharing authorization.
Private preview listens for disconnect before database lookup, preventing a lookup-time disconnect from stranding a transfer slot.
Client fetches use cancellation and the configured API origin is validated.

api.coldStartStabilityNote: An earlier full run exposed a 15.7-second cold-start timeout in the new Fastify route test. Only that integration test received a justified 30-second timeout; the complete post-fix suite then passed.

qualityDecision: Register a trusted real-room photograph or scan aligned to the same camera views.
Complete blinded human review of the aligned reference comparisons.
Obtain moving/orbit stability, load-time, frame-rate, GPU-memory, and supported-device evidence.
Resolve the structural room crop/floor-boundary control; both current structural inputs fail HORIZONTAL_ROOM_ENVELOPE_NOT_FOUND.
publicActivation: Create and review the exact immutable presentation contract and make the browser apply it.
Provision the dedicated private bucket, copy and byte-verify the reviewed objects, and prove anonymous and legacy-public retrieval is denied.
Apply the required migrations and register the exact package, transform, QA, and presentation evidence.
Deploy aggregate edge/WAF limits because process-local controls do not aggregate across API replicas.
Capture and review the real protected product route before enabling the showcase.

claimLimitations: The two candidates were captured from the same optical centre with static views; this is not motion, orbit, device, or performance evidence.
PSNR, SSIM, MAE, Gaussian count, sharpness, or file size alone cannot establish physical accuracy or user-perceived quality.

The preliminary JPEG-under-PNG-name incident is an operator session report only; the rejected bytes, hash, timestamp, and raw checker output were not retained. The final 24 PNGs are independently verifiable.
No protected-route, deployment, storage-policy, or public-release proof was produced.
No generated enhancement was used or accepted as captured truth, metric authority, collision authority, route authority, or safety evidence.
